title: Text: DET Sam Menzin ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: You guys would’ve got a comp pick for Nick, right? $64 mill...even though it’s got opt-outs
(If you would’ve held onto him, not traded)
Feels like that should be addressed, IMO. Not sure how you do it, but the deal could really be $16 mill if he opts out.
Hypothetically, a team signing another team’s player inside the division could dress up a 1-year deal for them to lose a draft pick, no? Team options?
